title: Hold
description: Platform-agnostic hold record schema for OTAS token primitives

holdId.description: Unique identifier for this hold — keccak256 hash in EVM, string key in Fabric

holder.description: Address or identity of the token holder whose balance is locked

notary.description: Address or identity authorised to execute or release this hold — CCP or SettlementManager

amount.description: Number of tokens locked under this hold

expiry.description: Unix timestamp after which the hold can be reclaimed by anyone

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the hold
